# clihelp -col showrcopy
col,showrcopy - Explanation of column headers for showrcopy

showrcopy has these sub-tables

Target columns:
Name            Name of the target.
ID              System assigned ID of the target.
Type            Target type, can be either FC (Fibre Channel) or IP (Internet
                Protocol).
Status          Status of the target, can be one of:
                    new         The target's links have yet to come up.
                    ready       The target has connected links.
                    unsupported The target system's tpd version is not
                                compatible with this system's version.
                    failing     The target's links have all failed but its
                                groups have not yet been stopped.
                    failed      The target's links have all failed and its
                                groups have been stopped.
                    disabled    The target has been disabled.
Options         Target options, with FC targets this includes the target
                system's node WWN.
Policy          Any policies that are set for the target. It can be
                mirror_config or no_mirror_config. With mirror_config,
                all configuration commands involving the specified
                target are duplicated. With no_mirror_config, the commands
                are not duplicated. If not specified, all configuration
                commands are duplicated.
Version         Remote Copy version.
Socks           Number of sockets.
Buffsz          Buffer size.  0 for "autotunelinks".
SysName         Remote system's name.
SysID           Remote system's ID.
RemoteName      Remote system's name for this system.
RemoteID        Remote system's ID for this system.
State           State of the target, can be one of:
                    normal   target is operating normally.
                    degraded target is in degraded state.
                    failed   target is operating abnormally.
QW-IP           QW IP address.
Q-Status        QW status.
Q-Status-Qual   QW status qualifiers.

Link columns:
Target          Target name with which this link is affiliated.
Name            Name of link.
IPC             IPC name.
ID              System assigned ID of the link.
Node            Location (node, slot and port (N:S:P)) of this link. For IP
                links, if the link was created with just node then only node is
                displayed.
Address         The address to which the link connects.
Status          Status of the link, can be one of:
                    Not Started Link has not been started.
                    Down        Link is not currently up.
                    Up          Link is currently up.
                    Exited      Link failed to be started.
                    Degraded    Link is degraded.
Options         Options that are set for this link
State           State of the link, can be one of:
                    normal   link is operating normally.
                    degraded link is in degraded state.
                    failed   link is operating abnormally.

Group columns:
Name            Name of the group.
ID              System assigned ID of the group.
Target          Target to which the group is mirrored.
Status          Current status of the group for this target, can be one of:
                    New             Group has yet to be started for this target.
                    Starting        Group is in the process of being started to
                                    this target.
                    Started         Group is currently started for this target.
                    Stopped         Group is currently stopped for this target.
                    Backup          This target of the group is the non-active
                                    target for a multi-target group.
                    Restart         Group will be restarted once system
                                    startup is completed.
                    Failsafe        The primary group is unable to reconcile
                                    the state of the secondary group and will
                                    be held in failsafe state until the
                                    problem is resolved. Use the setrcopygroup
                                    command with the override subcommand to
                                    force the group out of failsafe state.
                    Logging         Group has been stopped due to replication
                                    resources dropping below sustainable limits.
Role            Can be either Primary or Secondary.  Optionally followed by
                "-Rev".
Mode            Can be Sync, Async or Periodic.
LocalUserCpg    CPG name for which the user space is allocated if -createvv
                option is used for admitrcopyvv command. It will only be used
                after failover and recover.
RmUserCpg       CPG name for which the user space is allocated on remote target
                if -createvv option is used for admitrcopyvv command.
Options         Options that are set for the group.
State           State of the group, can be one of:
                    normal   group is operating normally.
                    degraded group is in degraded state.
                    failed   group is operating abnormally.

Volume columns:
LocalVV   ID    Volume name and ID on this system.
RemoteVV  ID    Volume name and ID on the target system.
SyncStatus      Synchronization status of the volume, can be one of:
                    New              Remote copy for the volume has not started.
                    New-SyncFromSnap Remote copy for the volume has not started.
                                     When the group is started the volume will
                                     be synced from the snapshot that was
                                     specified when the volume was admitted to
                                     the group.
                    New-PreSynced    Remote copy for the volume has not started.
                                     When the group is started the volume will
                                     not undergo an initial sync.
                    New-Pending      A New status is pending.
                    Syncing          The secondary volume is currently being
                                     synchronized with the primary.
                    Synced           The primary and secondary volumes are
                                     currently in sync (for periodic mode
                                     volumes this indicates the last
                                     synchronization completed).
                    NotSynced        The primary and secondary volumes are not
                                     in sync.
                    Failsafe         The volume is unavailable to be exported to
                                     attached hosts until the state of the
                                     volume on the secondary is reconciled. Use
                                     the setrcopygroup override command to
                                     force the group out of failsafe state.
                    Stale            The secondary virtual volume has a valid
                                     point-in-time copy of the primary volume;
                                     however, the last attempt at
                                     synchronization failed.
                    Logging          Group has been stopped due to replication
                                     resources dropping below sustainable
                                     limits.
                    Pending-Dismiss  A dismiss is pending for the volume.
                    Stopped          Syncing has been stopped for volume.
Resync_ss       Resync snapshot indicates the starting point of the remote
                volume.
                On the primary array this snapshot is used to determine the
                delta changes that should be synced to the secondary volume.
                On the target array this is the snapshot that will be used as a
                recovery point in case of a resync operation failure.
Sync_ss         Sync snapshot is a snapshot indicating the destination point of the
                remote copy volume on successful completion of the resync
                operation, i.e.  On completion of a resync the remote base RC
                volume will mirror this sync snapshot.
                This snapshot will become the resync snapshot when the resync
                operation completes.
VV_iter         The volume iteration number is a correlator used to determine
                the data consistency point of the volume relative to the remote
                volume and/or snapshots.
R_iter          The resync snapshot iteration number is a correlator used to
                determine the data consistency point of the resync snapshot
                relative to the remote volume and/or snapshots.
S_iter          The sync snapshot iteration number is a correlator used to
                determine the data consistency point of the sync snapshot
                relative to the remote volume and/or snapshots.
LastSyncTime    Time of the last successful synchronization for the RC volume.
State           State of the volume, can be one of:
                    normal   volume is operating normally.
                    degraded volume is in degraded state.
                    failed   volume is operating abnormally.

Hosts columns:
ID              System assigned ID of the group.
Name            Name of the group.
HostName        Host/Hostset name admitted to the group.
Proximity       Host/Hostset Proximity.
